title: Client Catalogue Request
user: A tiny B2B seller that already maintains a product list and needs approved clients to request a quote or reorder without a full ecommerce store.
smallest_useful_product: A shareable, passwordless client catalogue imported from CSV with request-for-quote basket, POA items, stock note, and CSV/PDF handoff to the seller.
success_measure: A pilot seller receives 50% of repeat requests as structured baskets and reduces re-keyed line items by at least 75% in one month.
constraints: Avoid exposing stock counts or customer pricing by default; protect client links; make tax/pricing labels configurable; no payment-card handling in v1.
summary: Turn repeat orders into structured quote requests
